images.description: Industrial complex at night, use as a very low opacity (5-10%) background texture overlaid with #0B0E14 to give depth to the dashboard.
Industrial crane at night, use for the login/auth screen background with a heavy dark overlay.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a crisp, technical look. Size usually 16px to 20px in dense tables, 24px in headers.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use APCA guidelines where possible.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='create-bol-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent.core_directive: Build a dense, command-center style dashboard. Maximize screen real estate. Use pure black/navy backgrounds with high-contrast neon accents for data visualization.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_structure: Implement a sticky top header, a fixed side navigation (or collapsible), and a main content area using CSS Grid. The main dashboard should feature a large interactive map widget spanning multiple columns, surrounded by smaller KPI widgets and lists.
instructions_to_main_agent.components_to_use: Use Shadcn components heavily: Cards, Tables, Dialogs, Selects, Tabs, ScrollArea. Customize them by removing default Vercel-like shadows and replacing them with 1px border-white/5 and flat dark backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts. Set axes lines to transparent, grid lines to white/5. Use glowing colors (Cyan, Emerald, Yellow, Rose) for the data series.
instructions_to_main_agent.map: Use 'react-simple-maps' or a similar library to render a dark-themed US/World map with pulsing SVG dots representing active shipments.
